##### Project general facts

Crystal Residences is an elegant residential development by Eagle Hills. This twelve-storey tower offers a collection of opulent waterfront units, including one to four-bedroom apartments, three to four-bedroom townhouses, and four-bedroom duplexes, all crafted with the sole purpose of providing the finest living experience. The building's architecture has been meticulously designed to provide natural shading for outdoor areas year-round, blending elegance and comfort with stunning views of the Arabian Gulf.

Crystal Residences is the first marina residence in Sharjah offering direct access to the Marina and promenade. Residents enjoy world-class amenities including an infinity pool for adults, a designated children's pool, a fully equipped fitness center, a play area, lounge areas, podium deck level garden houses, and a landscaped park with walking and jogging trails. Retail and dining outlets, along with direct access to the waterfront, complete this exceptional living experience.

Every residence at Crystal Residences is exquisitely designed with a modern touch to go above and beyond current norms of luxury and comfort. Interiors feature high-quality industrial wood and wood finish laminate for doors, cupboards, bedroom wardrobes, and kitchen cabinets. Kitchens are equipped with modern amenities, MDF panels, base and overhead cabinets with laminate finish, and reconstructed stone countertops with porcelain backsplash. Spacious balconies frame breathtaking views of the surrounding landscape, the tranquil waterfront promenade, and the Persian Gulf.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled on Maryam Island, a premier tourist destination celebrated for its pristine beach and scenic waterfront, this exceptional location offers residents seamless access to a fully developed infrastructure. Within walking distance, residents find retail shops, schools, kindergartens, medical facilities, essential services, and a variety of restaurants, creating a self-sufficient community.

The location is distinguished by its exceptional connectivity and proximity to key destinations. The Burj Khalifa is just a short drive away, while Dubai International Airport is within easy reach. Expo Centre Sharjah is also conveniently close, making the area ideal for both residents and visitors. The property offers the opportunity to stroll through a wide range of diverse retail and food and beverage outlets, thanks to its proximity to Maryam Island Park.

For those seeking a residence that embodies waterfront elegance, modern convenience, and a prime Sharjah location, Maryam Island delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of scenic beauty, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of the region's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of coastal living — serene, sophisticated and effortlessly connected.
